entry.title: Changelog: tramaj-cli
entry.content:
Changelog: tramaj-cli

Release history of tramaj-cli, the Node.js command-line interface built on the PureScript package. Releases happen when there are major changes rather than on a schedule; each entry below is one version. Every implementation has its own page like this one, and each page is tagged so the site builds one Atom feed per implementation: #changelog #purescript #tramaj-cli

The unreleased entry has breaking changes to numbers: Migrating to integers and floats says what to do about each.

tramaj-cli (none)unreleased

Bundled with spago; no registry release yet.

  • added Template file + JSON context file to evaluated Node JSON on stdout, with `--lib name=file` libraries and `--watch`.
  • added `analyze imports|actions|holes|unsupplied|constraints` subcommands over the static analyses.
  • changed Breaking: follows `tramaj-purs` in telling integers from floats. `3` and `3.0` stay two values from the context file to the output, a whole-valued float is written with a fraction (`1.0`), and a context with an integer outside -(2^53 - 1) to 2^53 - 1 is refused.
  • added `evaluate --arithmetic` turns the arithmetic builtins on for the run. Without it, an evaluation that fails names the arithmetic builtins the program references and the flag.
  • added `analyze arithmetic`, and an `"arithmetic"` field in `analyze all`: the arithmetic names a template and its libraries reference.
entry.summary: Release history of `tramaj-cli`, the Node.js command-line interface built on the PureScript package.

entry.title: Changelog: tramaj-hs
entry.content:
Changelog: tramaj-hs

Release history of tramaj-hs, the Haskell implementation, also the engine behind Kitchen-Sink’s templating sections. Releases happen when there are major changes rather than on a schedule; each entry below is one version. Every implementation has its own page like this one, and each page is tagged so the site builds one Atom feed per implementation: #changelog #haskell #tramaj-hs

The unreleased entry has breaking changes to numbers: Migrating to integers and floats says what to do about each.

tramaj-hs (none)unreleased

On the main branch after 0.3.0.0, not released yet: two number types and arithmetic.

  • changed Breaking: numbers are two types, an integer and a float (decisions section 18). A literal and a JSON number are typed by their text: `3` is an integer, `3.0` and `3e0` are floats. Integers cover the signed 64-bit range; one outside it is a parse error as a literal and a `TypeMismatch` in the context.
  • changed Breaking: a number keeps its type when written. `str(1.0)` is `1.0` where it was `1`, and every JSON boundary writes a float with a fraction or an exponent.
  • changed Breaking: `eq` never equates an integer with a float, and `lt`/`lte`/`gt`/`gte` take two integers or two floats; a mixed pair is a `TypeMismatch`.
  • changed Breaking: `Tramaj.Json` replaces `Data.Aeson.Value` in the public API, with `JInt` and `JFloat`; `fromAeson` and `toAeson` bridge the two.
  • changed Breaking: `"$term"` is a reserved object key, and `int` and `float` replace `number` as v4 type primitives.
  • added The arithmetic profile: `sum`, `product`, `negate`, `quotient`, `inverse`, `floor-quotient`, `modulo`, `floor` and `real`, and the `NotRepresentable` error. It is off by default: `Options`, `defaultOptions`, `evalProgramWith` and `runProgramWith` turn it on.
  • added Terms: over a symbol an arithmetic builtin evaluates to `{"$term": op, "arguments": [...]}`, with its operands as written.
  • added `arithmeticOps` and `deepArithmeticOps`, the arithmetic names a program references.

tramaj-hs 0.3.0.0date not recorded

Implements v2 of the language: a rewrite of the semantic core, not an extension of it.

  • changed Documents are expressions: `Element` and `Fragment` are ordinary `Expr` constructors; the separate template-phase AST and `JsonProgram` are gone.
  • added `Tramaj.Node`, the normative interchange format, with an encoder and a strict decoder.
  • added `Tramaj.Analysis`: static import names, action keys, context holes, context reads and unsupplied params, with deep variants.
  • changed Imports take their parameters three ways (expression, `ctx(path)`, or later call); `partial-import` is gone.
  • changed `a <> b` concatenation, lazy `branch`, `adapt-actions`, `.(a, b)` fragments, string escapes, object shorthand, builtins as values.
  • fixed Malformed `action(...)`/`value(...)` in an element argument no longer backtracks into a meaningless `Call`; a backtick in a static string position is reported.

tramaj-hs 0.2.0.0date not recorded

Adds a JSON-producing mode for hosts that want the data half of the language on its own.

  • added `Tramaj.Ast.JsonProgram`, `Tramaj.Parser.parseJsonProgram` and `Tramaj.Eval.evalJsonProgram`.

tramaj-hs 0.1.0.0date not recorded

Initial release, extracted from the repository it was written in.

  • added Ports the PureScript package's `Tramaj.Ast` / `Tramaj.Parser` / `Tramaj.Eval` to megaparsec + aeson.
entry.summary: Release history of `tramaj-hs`, the Haskell implementation, also the engine behind Kitchen-Sink's templating sections.

entry.title: Changelog: tramaj-purs
entry.content:
Changelog: tramaj-purs

Release history of tramaj-purs, the reference PureScript implementation: parser, evaluator, Node codec and analyses. Releases happen when there are major changes rather than on a schedule; each entry below is one version. Every implementation has its own page like this one, and each page is tagged so the site builds one Atom feed per implementation: #changelog #purescript #tramaj-purs

The unreleased entry has breaking changes to numbers: Migrating to integers and floats says what to do about each.

tramaj-purs (none)unreleased

Consumed as a git dependency; no registry release yet.

  • added Reference implementation of the language: parser, evaluator (concrete and symbolic modes), normative Node JSON codec and static analyses.
  • added Conformance corpus under `corpus/cases`, shared with every other implementation.
  • added Object destructuring patterns in `@` bindings and lambda parameters (decisions section 17): a parser lowering to plain `Let`/`Lambda`, checked by shared corpus cases 100-118.
  • changed Breaking: numbers are two types, an integer and a float (decisions section 18). A literal and a JSON number are typed by their text: `3` is an integer, `3.0` and `3e0` are floats. Integers cover -(2^53 - 1) to 2^53 - 1; an integer outside that range is a parse error as a literal and a `TypeMismatch` in the context.
  • changed Breaking: a number keeps its type when written. `str(1.0)` is `1.0` where it was `1`, and every JSON boundary writes a float with a fraction or an exponent.
  • changed Breaking: `eq` never equates an integer with a float, and `lt`/`lte`/`gt`/`gte` take two integers or two floats; a mixed pair is a `TypeMismatch`.
  • changed Breaking: `Tramaj.Json` replaces `Data.Argonaut.Core.Json` in the public API, with a reader and a writer that keep the type of a number.
  • changed Breaking: `"$term"` is a reserved object key, and `int` and `float` replace `number` as v4 type primitives.
  • added The arithmetic profile: `sum`, `product`, `negate`, `quotient`, `inverse`, `floor-quotient`, `modulo`, `floor` and `real`, and the `NotRepresentable` error. It is off by default: `evalProgramWith` and `runProgramWith` take an `Options` record that turns it on.
  • added Terms: over a symbol an arithmetic builtin evaluates to `{"$term", "arguments"}`, with its operands as written.
  • added `arithmeticOps` and `deepArithmeticOps`, the arithmetic names a program references.
entry.summary: Release history of `tramaj-purs`, the reference PureScript implementation: parser, evaluator, Node codec and analyses.

entry.title: Changelog: tramaj-halogen
entry.content:
Changelog: tramaj-halogen

Release history of tramaj-halogen, the Halogen host: folds an evaluated Node into Halogen.HTML. Releases happen when there are major changes rather than on a schedule; each entry below is one version. Every implementation has its own page like this one, and each page is tagged so the site builds one Atom feed per implementation: #changelog #purescript #tramaj-halogen

The unreleased entry has breaking changes to numbers: Migrating to integers and floats says what to do about each.

tramaj-halogen (none)unreleased

Consumed as a git dependency; no registry release yet.

  • added `Tramaj.Halogen.foldToHalogen`, wiring each `action(...)` to the host's own Action type.
  • changed Breaking: a scalar is rendered by its type, as `str` writes it: an integer as its digits, a float always with a fraction or an exponent. The float `1.0` renders as `1.0` where it rendered as `1`.
  • changed Breaking: takes `Tramaj.Json` values where it took Argonaut's, following `tramaj-purs`.
  • fixed An integer beyond 32 bits is no longer rendered with a fraction.
  • added A term renders as the call that built it, such as `sum(#0, 1)`, in a `code` element in text position, like a symbol.
entry.summary: Release history of `tramaj-halogen`, the Halogen host: folds an evaluated Node into Halogen.HTML.
